name: zed_3
note: Same voxel-smalls family as zed_1.rig.json -- read that file's note for the
scale 0.9) and the measurement method. zed_3 is built from Zed_3.obj and
shares zed_1's torso/head/leg proportions almost exactly: crotch at world
y=0.59 (leg gap closes 0.55->0.60), shoulder line at y=1.40, top of head
at y=1.80. legR/legL and torso/head/hips joints below are copied unchanged
DIFFERENCE: zed_3's left arm hangs straight like zed_1's (shoulder y=1.40
to hand y=0.62), but its RIGHT arm is a different, shorter pose -- the far-x
point cloud (x<-0.15) only spans world y=0.98..1.40, about half the left
arm's length, with no x/z drift suggesting a visible elbow kink (checked
with _armcentroid_probe.mjs at 0.03 m resolution). Read as a raised/bent
right arm (hand near the sternum, forearm not visibly separable from the
torso silhouette at this resolution) rather than a hanging arm. armR_upper
and armR_fore below are shortened to that measured span; the elbow split
(y=1.19) is a straight-line guess between the two measured endpoints, same
caveat as zed_1's elbow. This is the joint most likely to need a tuning
pass -- verify with --debug-colors before trusting it.
No overrides: nothing else in the point cloud reads nearer the wrong bone.

joints.comment: Shortened vs zed_1: measured far-x span is world y=0.98..1.40, roughly half the hanging arm's length -- read as raised/bent, not hanging.
